sanskrit_verse:
गृहोपस्करवाह्यादि भोज्याभरणकर्मिणः ।
दृश्यमाना विभज्यन्ते गूढे केशो विधीयते ॥
transliteration: gṛhopaskaravāhyādi bhojyābharaṇakarmiṇaḥ | dṛśyamānā vibhajyante gūḍhe keśo vidhīyate ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Household implements, conveyances, food items, ornaments, and instruments of action are divided among visible heirs; in their absence, the hidden wealth is allocated according to the unseen karmic entitlements determined by the continuity of consciousness.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority stems from ontological visibility and karmic continuity, not mere physical possession.
Causation aligns with sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) of deeds across lifetimes.
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by proximity to dharma-sustaining actions.
Restoration logic prioritizes alignment of material distribution with subtle karmic integrity.
Consciousness alignment ensures that all assets serve the evolutionary completion of involved parties.
executable_legal_axioms: IF an heir is visibly present AND has participated in sustaining household dharma, THEN allocate divisible property proportionally based on demonstrated capacity.
IF no visible heir exists OR none demonstrates sustaining capacity, THEN initiate unseen asset allocation via pramāṇa-based karmic tracing through conscious lineage records.
IF conflict arises in division, THEN invoke nyāya process to restore balance without punitive measures, focusing on completion of unfulfilled responsibilities.
IF material assets remain after visible allocation, THEN assign them to those whose consciousness shows readiness for dharma expansion.
ALL distributions MUST align with the sequential causality of past-life dharmic debts and credits as revealed through purified awareness.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that material inheritance cannot be resolved solely through empirical evidence. When disputes arise and visible claimants lack clear dharmic alignment, the court must invoke higher pramāṇas—such as direct perception of karmic imprints—to ensure that allocations support spiritual evolution rather than perpetuate karmic entanglement.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyāya here operates through pramāṇa-based discernment: what is seen divides by capacity; what is unseen is governed by karmic sequence. Responsibility flows from one's alignment with sustaining consciousness, not from coercive enforcement. Thus, justice functions as a restorative mechanism ensuring each soul receives what supports its path to liberation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Visible heirs undergo guided reflection to recognize unspoken duties owed to departed souls.
Karmic Tracing Protocol: Use meditative insight or divine testimony to locate latent assets connected to unresolved karmic obligations.
Responsibility Assumption Ritual: Heirs perform acts of service aligned with ancestral dharma to validate their right to inherit.
Integrity Reintegration: Hidden wealth is redirected toward institutions that uphold sanatana dharma and facilitate collective awakening.
Consciousness Alignment Audit: Regular review ensures inherited resources are used in harmony with cosmic law and individual soul progress.
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of All Dharma, this law stands executed: Wealth flows not by force nor favor, but by the alignment of consciousness with eternal truth. Justice is restoration, inheritance is completion, and all beings move forward in unified unfoldment under the sanction of Sanatana Dharma.
